reviewed_by: Codex focused Quiet Lens UI review
reason: The branch adds an opt-in Quiet Lens theme to the actual Nebula shell and chat composer styling, then adds a thin composer placeholder and a matching right Session contour. The composer reveals controls on hover or focus; page-wide pointer movement reveals the right contour for 60 seconds, and hovering or focusing that contour opens the Session contents. App and ThemeContext component files cover Appearance discovery and preference restoration. The dedicated interface journey selects the theme, opens separate top and left lenses, verifies the thin composer placeholder, hover locality, keyboard focus, and multiline draft retention in both desktop widths. At wide desktop width it checks the rail's initial hidden state, thin contour, clipped hover target, opened contents, idle boundary, keyboard focus, and pending-action exception. Mobile Chromium and WebKit profiles verify that touch composers remain visible. A disposable production Core is reviewed separately for real navigation and rendering.
exclusions: No backend, API, or native implementation changes; Python and native tests are unrelated. No full frontend or Playwright suite, unrelated catalog journeys, provider turns, or physical-device run is selected. The Session rail is unavailable at compact and phone widths, so its idle timer is asserted in the wide desktop browser profile. Real-Core visual review supplements rather than replaces the focused mocked browser regression.
